verdict: Paid campaigns remain paused; organic is holding but needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, all paid activity on Meta and Google has been paused, meaning zero ad spend and zero paid leads this period. Your organic presence — Google Business Profile and search — has been carrying all inbound activity, but that foundation is showing strain: Business Profile engagement dropped 75% in the last 7 days, and search clicks fell 32% week over week. These declines are being investigated and a posting cadence for your Business Profile is being put in place this month to stabilize visibility. Paid campaigns and CRM automation are on track to be active by end of September, which is when you should expect lead volume to begin building.
